interpretation: The backend explicitly failed before the Linux engine became available, at a named local Secrets Engine runtime endpoint. This supports a socket-related startup failure, not a Docker account or missing database volume diagnosis. The root cause of the inaccessible reparse point is not established.
proposed_reversible_action: After root confirms the failed owned Docker process family is stopped and resolves the source/target paths, preserve only the ordinary single-entry docker-secrets-engine runtime directory by renaming it to a unique sibling. Allow Docker to recreate the original runtime directory. Do not delete the original directory, reset Docker, unregister WSL, or change volumes/VHD/settings.
proposal_status: The diagnostic agent did not mutate the system. Root subsequently attempted targeted repair; it failed on this host. Docker has not been restored by these attempts.
